name: assumption-check
description: A side pane of the assumptions Claude makes, one dropdown per prompt: reinforce one, mark it wrong (type the fix or let Claude ask), ask why, pin and export. Off until /assumption-check on; unmarked cards change nothing.

startOn.title: Start on
startOn.description: Turn assumption capture on in every session. Off (the default), Claude works exactly as without the mod until you run /assumption-check on.
